dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: The Sentou ceremony used to be used to chase vishaps away. This is the clash between the human and vishap realms.

dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: Once the Daninichi Mikoshi was built, the Sentou ceremony was used less and less. However, as a secret art of the human realm, it can certainly still serve as an effective measure against the darkness.
